reviewSamples.author: Photo of Danielle Beltre-Hall
reviewSamples.text: I spent $128 on a remote key. The battery stopped working after 2 days. After a month, the key broke (the key detached from the fob). When I went to ask if it could be fixed, I was told I would have to buy a new one for more than $100, again. I’ll buy a new remote key, but not from this place. Will never return.
